Chicken keeping is hard. Really hard.

And yes - seasonal molting is normal.

They can stress the gut, drain nutrients, and leave your hens without what they need for strong laying, healthy feathers, and good condition.
But don’t ignore what may be happening inside the hen.
Here’s What I Tell Chicken Keepers When Dirty Eggs Start Showing Up:
In chickens, there’s this one thing that controls everything: Their gut.

When stressed, parasites attach to the gut lining and steal nutrients meant for your chickens.
Studies show 80-90% of backyard chickens have parasites right now.
